checkpoints.description: [1/1] Strict positive-integer guards on deposit, withdraw, depot sale, quantum order and AI trade

impact_assessment.why: ADR-162 left these coercing bool/float/string quantities by int() or max(1), so direct engine calls could mint or truncate cargo
impact_assessment.benefits: All quantity entry points now match the repair convention; nothing changes for REST/CLI callers that already parse ints
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stricter direct-engine API, no save change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: untouched on refusal
impact_assessment.mitigation: one shared helper, six failing-first tests including state snapshots, full suite and mechanics gates

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Size the AI captain's cargo decisions by volume and expose cargo volume in the snapshot

impact_assessment.why: The captain compared unit counts to a volume capacity, so it kept buying into a full hold and produced 173 wasted refusals in 600 steps
impact_assessment.benefits: The captain stops wasting steps and every client gets real used/free volume instead of guessing
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive snapshot fields; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: fallback keeps old payloads working; refusals measured before and after; four policy tests plus two snapshot tests
